rig: MPFB game_engine (53 bones) + antigrav, 6 cape bones, weapon_r socket
godot_target: Godot 4.7 PhysicalBoneSimulator3D + PhysicalBone3D children of the Skeleton3D

conventions.space: body_offset / joint_offset are Transform3D in the bone-local frame of the imported Skeleton3D bone (Blender bone frame, +Y along the bone)
conventions.capsule_axis: local Y (CapsuleShape3D default); height = total incl. caps
conventions.hinge_axis: joint frame Z; engine hinge angle = -(right-hand rotation of the child about Z)
conventions.limits: degrees, relative to the bind pose

mass_assumption: 2.35 m Floater, organs largely removed: anti-grav ball + tube 45 kg (rigid, grafted: one body with the lower torso / skirt), head 11 kg, cape 6 x 1 kg, the remaining flesh by fitted volume (lower torso 20 %)
non_simulated: Root, spine_01, neck_01, clavicles, digits, antigrav (rigid with pelvis), weapon_r and the unused leg bones follow their parents

shape.note: ConvexPolygonShape3D points in the body frame

bones.meaning: positive = more elbow flexion; bind pose already flexed 35.3 deg
positive = more elbow flexion; bind pose already flexed 35.3 deg

footprint_rule.rule: User decision 2026-10-01: no containment box or tile walls; gentle push only. Drop tests report how far anything ends outside the 2 m x 2 m tile as tuning information.
footprint_rule.origin: tile centre on the walking surface (unit origin)

handoff.initial_velocity: continue the clip: per-bone linear/angular velocity from the last two frames of the variant
handoff.variant_rule: shot travel direction t in the unit frame (x = unit right, y = unit forward; glTF/Godot: x right, -z forward): t.y <= -0.707 -> Front, t.y >= 0.707 -> Back, else t.x > 0 -> Left, else Right. Play Death<variant>, hand off on its last frame with that variant's velocities. "Death" = DeathFront.

extra_push.direction: SHOT TRAVEL DIRECTION: the same delta_v (impulse = delta_v x body mass) on EVERY body in "bones" along the horizontal travel direction of the killing shot (root 2026-10-02)

variation.note: per death: rotate the push direction about the vertical by a uniform random angle in [-jitter, +jitter] and add a random vertical-axis spin of up to spin_jitter to spin_bone, so corpses differ; 0 disables

handoff.ground_clearance_rule: at the hand-off, if any collision shape is below the walking plane, lift all bodies by that depth + 2 mm before releasing them
handoff.no_turn: user decision 2026-10-02: no animated turn toward the attacker; the twist turns the body as physics

twist_toward_shooter.bodies: all (every PhysicalBone3D incl. the machine and the cape plates)
twist_toward_shooter.pivot: mass centre of all bodies at the hand-off (horizontal position)
twist_toward_shooter.scale: angle between the unit facing and the direction to the shooter / 180 deg: 0 front, 0.5 side, 1 behind
twist_toward_shooter.sign: toward the shooter (counter-clockwise seen from above when the shooter is on the unit's left); from directly behind pick the side at random per death
twist_toward_shooter.apply: at the hand-off, after the variant velocities and the push: for EVERY body angular_velocity += up*w; linear_velocity += (up*w) x (body centre - pivot), horizontal
twist_toward_shooter.contract: user / root 2026-10-02: 3x (7.5 rad/s) default; a unit may drop to a per-unit ceiling >= 2x (5.0) only if the Jolt mass-centre gate fails at 3x with the all-body push at 0.6 m/s
twist_toward_shooter.intent: he tries to turn round too late while falling away from the attack (user 2026-10-02)

handoff.fall_direction: away from the shooter (mass centre along the shot travel direction)

assist.rule: once the fall is over (simulation time >= after_s and every body slower than below_mps), raise the damping of every body to at least these values (Godot DAMP_MODE_REPLACE); Blender tests run without it

assist_late.rule: shared runtime contract (root 2026-10-02): after the first assist, once every body is slower than below_mps after after_s, raise every body's damping to at least these values

depenetration.rule: root 2026-10-02: at freeze, if the deepest skinned vertex is below the walking plane, lift the whole corpse by that depth (capped) - no visible pop

settle_and_freeze.action: freeze: copy the simulated bone poses into the Skeleton3D pose and stop the simulation

fit.method: vertex-cloud fit in bone frames, grown 10 mm

preflight.joint_limit_note: checked per variant in the unit lab (hand-off joint gaps)

blender_drop_tests.engine: Blender 5.1 rigid body (Bullet), 30 fps x 20 substeps, 60 iterations, split impulse, cone joints approximated by GENERIC 6-DOF limits, convex hull pelvis
